scope: Pure content-addressed composition that independently re-verifies one A5a portable Grid-terminal receipt and re-evaluates the exact executor identity through the merged A6a retained-currentness checkpoint at the Grid intent start timestamp. It is historical evidence composition, not effect admission.
core_invariant: A successful post-hoc recheck may show that the exact A5 executor credential was known-active under the exact retained A6 issuer-evidence head at the recorded Grid intent start. It does not prove that the original runtime consulted A6, that the effect was authorized, that consume-before-effect occurred, or that the task/effect succeeded.

risks: bind currentness to a different portable receipt
bind another Grid intent or handoff
controls: exact portable receipt, handoff and Grid intent digests/IDs reproduced in composite

risks: currentness checkpoint belongs to another principal
same principal name with a rotated credential
active current credential differs from the credential that signed A5
controls: A6 principal must equal verified A5 executor principal
A6 active credential digest must equal exact A5 executor credential digest

risks: caller selects a more convenient currentness time
stale checkpoint stretched to cover work
controls: effectAt is forced to A5 Grid intent started_at
A6 rejects checkpoint evaluation after that boundary
A6 freshness ceiling remains at or below 60 seconds

risks: historical checkpoint reused while a newer retained checkpoint exists
post-hoc recheck described as evidence original effect path consulted currentness
composite marketed as late effect admission
known-active identity interpreted as task success
Grid completed state interpreted as concrete effect proof
two valid evidence objects combined into a bearer authority object
binding digest treated as a grant or signature

known_nonclaims: The composite is not signed and is not a bearer credential, grant, approval, delegation record, or capability token.
It does not prove the original effect path consulted A6 currentness evidence.
It does not prove consume-before-effect ordering.
It does not authorize an effect or establish global currentness.
It does not claim task success, application correctness, truth, artifact availability, or concrete effect execution.
It does not persist retained latest heads or add an independent currentness witness.
It does not modify Gateway, Hypervisor, Sandbox, Grid, capability state, or production policy.
next_gates: bind A6 currentness into an actual reviewed late effect-admission path and prove it was consulted before effect
bind consume-before-effect lifecycle evidence where a real executor path exists
A5b independently verify effect-specific receipts before narrower execution claims
retained latest-head recovery and independent witness/currentness research
